research_question: Can a re-packed 32-bit reversible program learn an optional third XOR shear from source-blind public FIT evidence, preserving BQ two-shear successes, rejecting hard false positives, and satisfying full nonregressing CPU/RSS?

representation.new_bit: optional third XOR shear output low driven by final high
representation.packed: odd gain six-bit indices, two 8-bit biases, two modes, third shear bit and zero reserve

selection.flag0: Raw output FIT from original two-shear graph
selection.flag1: Transform output y by ylow XOR yhigh, high unchanged, then BQ learn
selection.fit_only_preselection: For each flag transform only FIT, enumerate two stage-one modes and 64 odd gains and residual bias histograms; choose minimum stage-one FIT bit error across 40 public examples. Choose lower score, tie legacy flag 0. No CHECK or truth during branch selection.
selection.post_select: Call unchanged BQ.learn once with selected transformed 40 FIT and 8 CHECK. CHECK veto only; no post-CHECK fallback. Original FIT <=6 and CHECK <=2 unchanged. Native predecessor inverse reverses third XOR then original BQ inverse.
selection.fixed_search_cost: Two branch scans ×2 modes×64 odd gains×40 histogram observations + one whole BQ fit. More work than BQ may exceed original CPU/RSS; fail closed and retain.
selection.oracle_leakage: No source family, seed, private causal truth, graph label or CHECK consulted for flag selection.

admission.positive_and_hard_negative: Require graph positive retained, token-inventory matched wrong predecessor rejected without false positive.
admission.baseline_preservation: Verify original BQ control's correct acceptance on two-shear synthetic and successor same decision.
admission.work: Use AZ natural original scorer route with two calls on identical native graph and scorer work, never forced. Ineligible if no same work.
admission.resource: Five genuinely fresh whole-process Linux OS process samples per arm/case on same public input, total FIT plus native CPU and peak RSS. Candidate CPU median <= original eligible AZ median, candidate peak RSS median and maximum <= AZ for each eligible source-neutral case. Don't remove ineligible cases. Original model and native scorer unchanged.
admission.if_failure: Retain original negative, no retrofitting thresholds or reusing protected data.
